seg_date.policy: Frozen maximum absolute loss1percentage point, exact fractions; no post-test tuning or repeat locked inference. Original single-task freezes unchanged.

ppocrv6-medium.note: Line detector plus recogniser, not a prompt-equivalent VLM row; separate from PaddleOCR-VL 1.5.

not_scored.state: Rerun timed out at 7 h on 2026-10-20 with 839 of 895 pages read (631 ok, 207 cap). Not scored (partial). Owner, 2026-10-20: dropped as not competitive; no third submission.
Parked by the owner: three-page pilot 2 ok, 1 cap; no full run, no score.

open_sweep.status: Review baseline for the processing review (execution-plans/processing-review/00-plan.md, Phase 0). Nothing adopted; no catalogue or default changed.
open_sweep.hardware: One NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) per model unless gpus says otherwise. VLM routes: vLLM 0.31.0, context 16384, temperature 0, thinking off, 8192 output tokens; 16 sequences and 8 concurrent requests, except Ling 3 Flash VL on 4 L40S (tensor parallel 4 with expert parallel, eager, 4 sequences and 4 requests). PP-OCRv6 is not vLLM and not a VLM: the stock PaddleOCR 3.7.0 detector and recognizer pipeline, no prompt and no token cap. All routes read the same 2400 px JPEG 90 inputs as the Qwen runs (image SHA-256 checked page by page).
